lines.en: I shuffle along, belly leading
I pace a lap around the house

lines.zh: 脚尖点着地面，一颠一颠
lines.en: I bob on my toes
I wander over to the window

lines.zh: 我抱着一堆东西，走得很稳
lines.en: I carry a pile of things and walk steady

lines.zh: 我绕过桌子，没碰倒任何东西
lines.en: I go around the table without knocking anything

lines.zh: 我停下来，又想起来要做什么
lines.en: I stop, then recall what I was doing
I hum my way to the door

lines.zh: 我的脚印浅得几乎看不见
lines.en: My footprints are barely visible

lines.zh: 我踱到你旁边，慢慢坐下
lines.en: I stroll over and settle beside you

lines.zh: 我在院子里走了一圈，跟鸡打了招呼
lines.en: I do a lap of the yard and greet the chickens
I walk while patting my belly

lines.zh: 我盘着腿坐着，什么也不想
lines.en: I sit cross-legged and think nothing

lines.zh: 洞里的蒸汽慢慢往上飘
lines.en: Steam drifts up from my vents

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的手看了一会儿
lines.en: I study my own hand for a while
I find half a candy and lick it
Outside, the wind rattles the door

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，眼泪都出来了
lines.en: I yawn until my eyes water
I rest my head against the wall
I count the beams in the ceiling

lines.zh: 我的触须垂下来，晃啊晃
lines.en: My feeler hangs and sways
I laugh suddenly, for no reason
I hear your footsteps far off
I straighten a loose stone
This house is fine; I'll stay
I'm thinking about supper

lines.zh: 我的手在膝盖上打拍子
lines.en: My hand taps a rhythm on my knee
Quiet for a while is fine too
You're here; I've waited a while

lines.zh: 我抬头，笑得眼睛都没了
lines.en: I look up, smiling so hard my eyes vanish
Is there something you want to ask

lines.zh: 我把手在衣服上擦了擦
lines.en: I wipe my hands on my clothes

lines.zh: 你看起来累了，坐会儿吧
lines.en: You look tired; sit a while
I know you; you've been here
Let's talk; I've got time
Why are you standing so far off
My hands wave when I talk
Want candy? I've a little left
Your smell isn't familiar
I'll wait for you to finish before I speak
No need to be scared talking to me
I push a chair toward you
I cover the spot that was struck
I let out an ouch
I retreat behind the table
I don't hit back; I only look at you
The smile has left my face

lines.zh: 我低头看了看衣服破的地方
lines.en: I look down at the tear in my clothes
I gasp and my steam scatters
I sit down to catch myself
This is no way to treat a guest
I wait for you to stop
Is that a snack? I can smell it
Give me a little, just a little
I reach out, then pull back
Let me try one bite, all right
Sweet things are my favorite

lines.zh: 我把糖藏在洞里，慢慢吃
lines.en: I'll hide the candy and eat it slowly
I'll watch while you eat
I won't snatch it; I'll only look
This will keep me happy all day
Thank you; you're kind
You bump me and I barely shift
I make room and you pass

lines.zh: 我撞到门框，木屑落下来
lines.en: I bump the doorframe and sawdust falls
You run into my belly; it's soft
We crowd the doorway and both laugh
I steady you with a hand
Some dust got on me

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，小心点
lines.en: You squeeze past me; be careful
I move my leg and you nearly trip
I step back to give you room
I think of some things from long ago
I split my candy in half
It's good to have someone to talk to
I move my chair a little closer
We sit without saying anything
I fold my hands on my knees

lines.zh: 我忽然觉得这屋子没那么空
lines.en: The house feels less empty now

lines.zh: 我讲了一个很长的故事
lines.en: I tell a very long story
I laugh, softly
I plan to stay here a long while
I bend and pick it up carefully
This could be traded, maybe
I put it into my bag
I don't understand it, but it's pretty
I heft it in my hand
This one goes on the shelf
I dropped it; I'll pick it up again
I hand it to whoever's near
Is this yours? Take it back
I'll keep it safe; thanks from me

lines.zh: 我看了看门，又看了看你
lines.en: I glance at the door, then at you
You've come for business, I'd guess
No rush; I'll hear you out

lines.zh: 我把手从袖子里拿出来
lines.en: I draw my hands out of my sleeves
Who's making such a noise outside
Let me see what's going on
Need work? I've got some
I'll keep the doorway, that's all
No fighting in this house
I stand and brush off my clothes

lines.zh: 有人来了，我认得这脚步
lines.en: Someone's come; I know that step
Go on; I'm here listening
I stand in the doorway and don't move
Whatever's outside is none of my business
I look, then sit back down
Fight somewhere else
I close the door a little
I'd like to keep living here

lines.zh: 我伸头看了一眼，就退回屋
lines.en: I peek out, then retreat inside

lines.zh: 我数了数外面有几个人
lines.en: I count how many are out there
I don't like noise
Come in, if you're coming
I sit and let you decide
I won't move; you don't either
My tea is going cold

lines.zh: 我抬起手，只是挡了一下
lines.en: I raise a hand only to block

lines.zh: 我推了你一把，把你推远
lines.en: I shove you back a step
I'm not hitting you, only stopping you

lines.zh: 这一下我把你的剑按下去
lines.en: I press your sword down

lines.zh: 我拍了拍你的肩，力气大了点
lines.en: I pat your shoulder a bit too hard
I shield what's behind me

lines.zh: 我用手臂挡在你和我之间
lines.en: I put my arm between us
Don't force me to hit back
I've given ground; give some too

lines.zh: 我把你推到你自己的影子里
lines.en: I push you back into your own shadow
I rise from the corner of the room

lines.zh: 蒸汽先冒出来，然后是我
lines.en: Steam comes first, then me

lines.zh: 我把门推开，慢慢走进来
lines.en: I push the door open and come in

lines.zh: 我在屋里等着，一直等着
lines.en: I wait in the house, always waiting
There are snacks left on the table
The wind's up; I close the door

lines.zh: 有人来了吗？我听见脚步
lines.en: Is someone here? I heard steps
I've lived here a long while
I smile once as a greeting
I keep this house tidy
My shadow reaches the wall before I do
I emerge from the steam
If there's business, say it

lines.zh: 火烧到我的衣服，我拍了好几下
lines.en: Fire catches my clothes and I slap at it

lines.zh: 我从椅子上摔下来，还坐着
lines.en: I fall off the chair, still sitting

lines.zh: 水呛进鼻子，我说不出话
lines.en: Water in my nose; I can't speak

lines.zh: 爆炸把屋里的东西全掀了
lines.en: The blast scatters everything in the room
An arrow pins my sleeve
Magic presses me down and I can't move

lines.zh: 我光顾着等你，忘了吃东西
lines.en: I waited for you and forgot to eat

lines.zh: 雷打进屋里，我吓了一跳
lines.en: Lightning hits the house and I jump

lines.zh: 脚下的地板没了，我往下掉
lines.en: The floor's gone and I'm falling
